messages:
maria: heads up — seeing a sudden drop in available spot gpus in us-west-2, about 40% gone in the last 6m :rotating_light:. anyone else seeing this?
kevin: yup i see it, pod pending spike on infer-gpu pool. autoscaler not pulling new warm nodes.
ash: looks like cloud provider issued a maintenance surge. i've got preemptible churn alerts from the billing hook.
nina: tagging for visibility @sre-oncall — can we trigger the spot-fallback run?
sre-oncall: on it. first step: enable fallback routing to reserved-gpu and set low-priority queues to evictable.
sre-oncall: quick checklist i'm running through: 1) cordon suspect nodes 2) drain low-priority pods 3) scale reserved pool 4) bump autoscaler cooldowns
maria: adding to the runbook: we should have a one-liner to cordon+drain all nodes with label pool=spot-usw2 that are non-ready.
kevin: proposed command snippet:```bash
kubectl get nodes -l pool=spot-usw2 -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}' | xargs -n1 -P4 -I{} sh -c "kubectl cordon {}; kubectl drain {} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force"
```
ash: be careful to exclude nodes with annotation "redwood-critical=true" — those host reserved inference instances.
kevin: good call. update to filter:```bash
kubectl get nodes -l pool=spot-usw2,redwood-critical!=true -o name | xargs -n1 -P4 -I{} kubectl drain {} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
nina: anyone know if our autoscaler respects node taints? we should taint fallback nodes so only reserved workloads land there.
sre-oncall: yes, autoscaler respects podAffinity/taints. we'll apply taint key=rockfall:NoSchedule to reserved-fallback nodes and add tolerations to critical pods.
maria: escalation path recap (for runbook): 1) page oncall if >15% capacity lost for >10m 2) exec escalation to infra lead if fallback fails 3) notify eng-product for noisy customers 4) open a support ticket with provider if preemption rate >25%
kevin: add an instrumentation check: if pending pods >50 for 5m, send alert to #incidents and invoke fallback policy.
ash: small optimization: enable prefix-KV cache keepalive so existing sessions stay warm while we shift capacity.
sre-oncall: deploying policy changes now. will post deploy-bot update.
deploy-bot: INFO 2026-05-12T15:18:30Z - Applied taint rockfall:NoSchedule to nodegroup reserved-fallback-usw2. Autoscaler policy updated: cooldown=300s, scaleUpBalance=0.6
maria: thanks. followup for runbook text: include recommended cost guardrails — cap reserved burst to 20% of spot pool to avoid large cost spikes.
nina: also document SLA impact: expected latency increase up to 150ms for 5-15 minutes during migration.
kevin: i'll open a short doc PR with steps + commands + contact list.
maria: perfect. after PR we should run a drill next week to validate the steps. everyone ok with that?
ash: thumbs up :+1:
sre-oncall: acknowledged, scheduled drill for Tue 09:30 PT.
maria: closing thread — i'll link the PR here when done. thanks all.
